nodes.label: Database Business-Logic Triggers (0003_business_logic.sql)
nodes.rationale: Implements compute_message_preview, handle_new_message (auto-receipts + denormalized chat/channel previews), handle_message_update, handle_community_member_insert/delete (counter + auto-join community_chats), handle_channel_follower_insert/delete, and handle_chat_member_delete (auto-promote oldest member or cascade-delete empty group).

nodes.label: 13 Atomic SECURITY DEFINER RPCs
nodes.rationale: Provides controlled server-side mutations for tables where direct client INSERT is blocked by RLS: create_direct_chat_request (enforcing 7-day rejection cooldown), create_self_chat, create_group_chat, add_chat_member, accept_chat_request, reject_chat_request, create_channel, follow_channel, create_community, join_community, mark_chat_as_read, delete_message_for_everyone, and get_my_storage_usage.

nodes.label: Supabase Realtime Publication & pg_cron Housekeeping Jobs
nodes.rationale: Publishes messages, chat_members, calls, message_receipts, and stories to supabase_realtime (excluding chats to avoid high-frequency denormalized update noise) and schedules 4 pg_cron jobs for stale ringing calls, expired stories, pending uploads, and orphaned uploads.
